places.name: 来福士广场
places.hook: 八座塔楼由空中连廊相连，矗立于两江交汇处，是重庆最震撼的现代地标，站在观景台上，两江尽收眼底。
places.hook_en: Eight soaring towers connected by a sky bridge at the confluence of two rivers — the most dramatic modern landmark in Chongqing, with sweeping views from 250 metres up.
practical: 观景台门票约120元，含来回电梯
建议早上9点前到达，避开人流
商场内部免费参观，B2层有超市
practical_en: Observation deck ticket around RMB 120, includes lift
Arrive before 9am to beat the crowds
The mall itself is free to explore; supermarket on B2
food: B3美食广场有多家素食友好摊位
商场内有多家提供豆腐和蔬菜料理的餐厅
📖 素食提示：点餐时说明不要肉类
food_en: B3 food court has several vegetarian-friendly stalls
Multiple restaurants in the mall offer tofu and vegetable dishes
📖 Veg tip: say 'bu yao rou' (no meat) when ordering

places.name: 山城步道
places.hook: 穿行于重庆老城区的石板小径，爬上爬下感受山城独特地貌，巷弄里藏着老重庆人最真实的烟火生活。
places.hook_en: Wind through Chongqing's old stone-paved alleyways, up and down the hills that give this mountain city its name — real local life is hidden in every lane.
practical: 步道免费开放，全程约1至2小时
穿舒适的平底鞋，坡度较大
山城第二步道与第三步道相连，可自由选择路段
practical_en: Free to walk, allow 1–2 hours
Wear flat comfortable shoes — steep in places
Steps 2 and 3 connect; pick your preferred section
food: 沿途有本地摊贩售卖凉粉和糍粑
步道附近的十八梯有更多小吃选择
📖 素食提示：凉粉、糍粑均为素食
food_en: Local vendors along the way sell liangfen cold jelly noodles and sticky rice cakes
More snack options nearby at Shibati
📖 Veg note: liangfen and glutinous rice cakes are both vegetarian

places.name: 十八梯
places.hook: 重庆最著名的老街之一，因一段十八级台阶而得名，修复后保留了吊脚楼和老式茶馆，是感受旧重庆氛围最佳地点。
places.hook_en: Named after its 18 famous steps, this restored old district preserves the stilted wooden houses and teahouses of old Chongqing — the most atmospheric neighbourhood in the city.
practical: 免费进入，开放时间10:00至22:00
建议花1至2小时慢慢逛
下午光线较好，适合拍照
practical_en: Free entry, open 10:00–22:00
Allow 1–2 hours to wander
Afternoon light is best for photos
food: 街内有多家本地小吃摊，凉粉、豆腐脑均为素食
推荐本地豆花，嫩豆腐配各种蘸料
📖 素食提示：选择无肉馅料的小吃
food_en: Multiple local snack stalls inside — liangfen and tofu pudding are vegetarian
Try the local douhua soft tofu with dipping sauce
📖 Veg tip: choose snacks without meat fillings

places.name: 素食火锅午餐
places.hook: 重庆以麻辣火锅闻名全球，素食版本同样精彩，菌汤或番茄底料配上新鲜蔬菜和豆腐，是素食家庭的最佳选择。
places.hook_en: Chongqing is world-famous for hotpot — the vegetarian version is just as exciting. Mushroom or tomato broth loaded with fresh vegetables and tofu is the perfect family feast.
practical: 推荐提前网上预订，午餐高峰等位时间长
可要求鸳鸯锅，一半菌汤一半番茄
人均消费约60至100元
practical_en: Book ahead online — lunchtime queues can be very long
Ask for the split pot: half mushroom broth, half tomato
Budget around RMB 60–100 per person
food: 必点：金针菇、嫩豆腐、宽粉、藕片
蘸料选麻酱底，香浓不辣
📖 素食火锅：搜索附近标注素食或菌汤锅底的餐厅
food_en: Must order: enoki mushrooms, silken tofu, wide noodles, lotus root slices
For dipping sauce, choose sesame paste — rich and not spicy
📖 Search nearby for restaurants with mushroom broth or marked vegetarian hotpot

places.name: 解放碑
places.hook: 重庆的精神中心，这座建于1947年的胜利纪念碑如今伫立于最繁华的商业街核心，历史与现代在此交汇。
places.hook_en: The spiritual heart of Chongqing — this 1947 Victory Monument now stands at the centre of the city's busiest commercial district, where history and modern life meet.
practical: 全天免费参观，无需门票
附近购物中心林立，可顺便逛逛
傍晚华灯初上时气氛最佳，适合拍照
practical_en: Free to visit, no ticket needed
Surrounded by shopping malls if you want to browse
Most atmospheric at dusk when the lights come on
food: 附近步行5分钟可找到多家素食餐厅
酸辣粉去掉肉臊即为素食，是本地特色小吃
📖 地铁1号线或6号线至解放碑站可直达
food_en: Several vegetarian restaurants within a 5-minute walk
Sour and spicy noodles suanlafen are vegetarian if ordered without the meat topping
📖 Take Metro Line 1 or 6 to Jiefangbei station

places.name: 魁星楼
places.hook: 悬于山崖边缘的古楼，供奉掌管文运的魁星神，从此处俯瞰两江交汇，是拍摄重庆山城全景的绝佳角度。
places.hook_en: A historic tower perched dramatically at the cliff edge, dedicated to the god of literature. The view from here over both rivers meeting is one of the finest panoramas in Chongqing.
practical: 位于东水门历史文化街区内，步行可达
登楼约10至20元，凭票进入
下午4至6点光线柔和，拍照最佳
practical_en: Located in the Dongshuimen Historic District, walkable from central areas
Tower entry around RMB 10–20
Late afternoon 4 to 6pm has the softest light for photos
food: 附近东水门老街有传统小吃摊
可购买重庆特产伴手礼
📖 素食街头小食：凉粉、烤红薯均可找到
food_en: Nearby Dongshuimen Old Street has traditional snack vendors
Good spot to pick up local souvenirs
📖 Veg-friendly street snacks: cold jelly noodles and roasted sweet potato

places.name: 洪崖洞
places.hook: 十一层吊脚楼依崖而建，灯光亮起的夜晚宛如宫崎骏笔下的神秘城市，是重庆最上镜的打卡地。
places.hook_en: Eleven floors of stilted wooden buildings built into the cliff face — when the lights come on at dusk it looks like a scene straight out of Spirited Away. The most photographed spot in Chongqing.
practical: 免费进入，全天开放
建议傍晚6点后到达，灯光效果最佳
对面千厮门大桥上的视角最经典，不要错过
practical_en: Free entry, open all day
Arrive after 6pm for the best lighting effect
Don't miss the classic view from Qiansimen Bridge opposite
food: 楼内有重庆特色餐厅，素食选项有限，建议提前确认
附近滨江路有更多餐饮选择
📖 明日从此处旅游客运码头出发坐两江小渡
food_en: Restaurants inside the complex — vegetarian options are limited, confirm before ordering
More dining options along the riverside road nearby
📖 Tomorrow's ferry departs from the tourist pier right here

places.name: 两江小渡
places.hook: 从洪崖洞旅游码头出发，乘小渡船穿越嘉陵江，用当地人的方式感受山城两江，船上城市天际线尽收眼底。
places.hook_en: Hop on a small ferry from the Hongyadong tourist pier and cross the Jialing River — the way locals have moved around this river city for generations, with stunning skyline views from the water.
practical: 从洪崖洞旅游客运码头出发，步行可达
单程票价约2至5元，现金或支付宝均可
建议早上9点前出发，避开游客高峰
practical_en: Departs from Hongyadong Tourist Ferry Pier, a short walk from the complex
One-way ticket around RMB 2–5, cash or Alipay accepted
Go before 9am to avoid the tourist rush
food: 码头附近有早餐摊，可购买豆浆带上船
渡船对岸有小食摊
📖 豆浆为素食；油条可能含猪油，请询问
food_en: Breakfast stalls near the pier — grab a soy milk to take on board
Small food stalls at the landing on the other side
📖 Soy milk is vegan; fried dough sticks may contain lard, ask first

places.name: 弹子石老街
places.hook: 江南岸最具特色的历史街区，民国时期的洋楼与本地老宅并肩而立，还可眺望对岸重庆城市天际线，充满文艺气息。
places.hook_en: The most characterful historic district on the south bank — Republican-era villas stand beside old local houses, with some of the best views looking back across the river at Chongqing's dramatic skyline.
practical: 免费进入，建议游览1至2小时
从渡船码头步行约10分钟
街区内有艺术装置和独立咖啡馆
practical_en: Free entry, allow 1–2 hours
About 10 minutes walk from the ferry landing
Art installations and independent cafés throughout the district
food: 街内有独立咖啡馆和轻食店
本地糕点铺有花生糍粑和绿豆糕
📖 素食友好：花生糍粑、绿豆糕均为素食
food_en: Independent cafés and light food spots throughout
Local pastry shops sell peanut sticky rice and mung bean cakes
📖 Both peanut mochi and mung bean cake are vegetarian

places.name: 钟楼广场
places.hook: 南岸区标志性广场，古朴钟楼与江边风光相映成趣，是本地居民晨练和休闲的聚集地，充满真实的市井生活气息。
places.hook_en: The landmark square of the south bank — the old bell tower against the riverside backdrop is a favourite gathering spot for locals doing morning tai chi and enjoying the fresh river air.
practical: 全天免费开放，早晨气氛最佳
从弹子石老街步行约5至10分钟
广场旁有公共厕所
practical_en: Free and open all day; best atmosphere in the morning
About 5 to 10 minutes walk from Danzishipu Old Street
Public toilets available beside the square
food: 广场附近有传统早餐摊
重庆小面可要求素食版，去掉肉臊即可
📖 素食提示：小面去臊子即为素食
food_en: Traditional breakfast stalls around the square
Chongqing noodles xiaomian are a local staple — ask for no meat topping
📖 Xiaomian without the meat topping is fully vegetarian

places.name: 慈云寺
places.hook: 建于唐代的千年古寺，历经多次修缮仍保留古朴气息，寺内香烟袅袅，是闹市中难得的静谧之地，适合全家祈福。
places.hook_en: A Buddhist temple with over a thousand years of history, rebuilt and restored many times yet still calm and atmospheric — a peaceful family escape from the city's bustle.
practical: 门票约10至20元，开放时间8:00至17:00
进入寺庙请穿着得体，不宜穿暴露衣物
可在此上香祈福，功德香约5至10元
practical_en: Entry around RMB 10–20, open 8:00 to 17:00
Dress modestly inside the temple
Incense for offerings available for around RMB 5–10
food: 寺庙内或附近常设素斋，价格实惠
寺外小摊有素食小吃
📖 佛教寺庙素斋为全素，非常适合素食家庭
food_en: Vegetarian canteen often available inside or near the temple, very good value
Vegetarian snack stalls outside the gates
📖 Buddhist temple canteens are fully vegetarian — ideal for the family

places.name: 下酷里老街
places.hook: 南岸最有活力的创意街区之一，老建筑改造的咖啡馆和小吃摊云集，是重庆年轻人喜爱的聚集地。
places.hook_en: One of the most vibrant creative neighbourhoods on the south bank — old buildings converted into cafés, snack stalls and small shops, buzzing with Chongqing's young crowd.
practical: 免费进入，全天开放
下午2点后人气最旺
步行约10至15分钟可到龙门酷老街
practical_en: Free entry, open all day
Most lively after 2pm
About 10 to 15 minutes walk to Longmen Kuli Old Street
food: 有多家素食友好的轻食店和甜品店
推荐尝试重庆特色甜品：汤圆和醪糟
📖 素食甜品：无肉馅汤圆和醪糟均为素食
food_en: Several vegetarian-friendly cafés and dessert spots
Try Chongqing sweet snacks: glutinous rice balls and sweet fermented rice
📖 Non-meat rice balls and sweet rice wine are both vegetarian

places.name: 龙门酷老街
places.hook: 保存完好的民国风情街道，精品小店与地道小吃并排，到了傍晚灯笼亮起，是重庆最有腔调的老街之一。
places.hook_en: A well-preserved Republican-era street with boutique shops and authentic local snacks side by side — when the lanterns light up at dusk, it becomes one of Chongqing's most atmospheric old streets.
practical: 免费进入，傍晚5点后气氛最好
与下酷里老街相邻，可两处连逛
停车不便，建议打车或步行前往
practical_en: Free entry, best atmosphere after 5pm
Adjacent to Lower Kuli — easy to visit both together
Parking is difficult; better to walk or take a taxi
food: 街内有全素菜馆和豆花饭
推荐重庆豆花饭，嫩豆腐配多种素菜小碟
📖 豆花饭：嫩豆腐配素菜碟，重庆传统平民美食，天然素食
food_en: Fully vegetarian restaurants inside, plus douhua rice sets
Try Chongqing douhua fan — soft tofu with a spread of small vegetable side dishes
📖 Douhua fan is a traditional local working-class meal, naturally vegetarian

places.name: 荒野茶摊
places.hook: 隐于江边绿荫下的露天茶摊，简单的竹椅小桌，一壶清茶，感受老重庆人最爱的慢生活方式。
places.hook_en: A simple open-air tea stand tucked beneath the trees by the riverbank — bamboo chairs, small tables, a pot of tea. The most relaxed, unhurried slice of old Chongqing life.
practical: 一壶茶约10至30元，可坐半天
位于南岸区江边，导航搜索荒野茶摊
部分茶摊只收现金，请提前准备
practical_en: A pot of tea around RMB 10–30; you can sit for hours
Located on the south bank riverside — search for Huangye Chatan in maps
Some tea stands are cash only; have small notes ready
food: 茶摊提供各类清茶，推荐绿茶或茉莉花茶
附近有本地小贩售卖瓜子和花生
📖 瓜子和花生为素食，是配茶的传统小食
food_en: Green tea and jasmine tea are recommended
Local vendors nearby selling watermelon seeds and peanuts
📖 Sunflower seeds and peanuts are vegan — the classic tea-time snack

places.name: 长江索道
places.hook: 全世界少有的城市空中客运索道，横跨长江连接南北两岸，俯瞰大江与山城全景，是重庆独一无二的标志体验。
places.hook_en: One of the world's last urban passenger ropeways — originally built to carry commuters across the Yangtze River, now a bucket-list ride with breathtaking views over the river and the mountain city.
practical: 单程票约10元，来回约20元
开放时间7:00至21:30，建议傍晚搭乘
排队等候约20至40分钟，请预留时间
practical_en: One way around RMB 10, return around RMB 20
Open 7:00 to 21:30; take it at dusk for the best views
Expect a 20 to 40 minute queue; factor this into your plans
food: 索道两端附近均有小吃摊
返回北岸后可在附近寻找晚餐
📖 北岸站附近有素食餐厅可供晚餐选择
food_en: Snack stalls at both ends of the ropeway
Head back to the north bank for more dinner options
📖 Vegetarian restaurants near the north bank station for dinner

places.name: 李子坝光景平台
places.hook: 全球最奇特的城市景观之一：轻轨列车穿越居民楼6至8层，在对面观景平台上亲眼目睹这一重庆独有的神奇一幕。
places.hook_en: One of the most surreal urban sights in the world — a light rail train passes directly through floors 6 to 8 of a residential apartment block. Watch it happen from the viewing platform across the road.
practical: 观景平台免费，无需门票
列车约5至10分钟一班，最佳观景位置在马路对面
建议早上9点前到达，避开拍照人群
practical_en: Free viewing platform, no ticket needed
Trains run every 5 to 10 minutes; best spot is directly across the road
Arrive before 9am to beat the photo crowds
food: 附近有本地早餐店，推荐重庆小面
李子坝站附近有多家咖啡馆
📖 素食早餐选项：豆浆、素包子、酸辣粉去肉
food_en: Local breakfast shops nearby — try Chongqing noodles xiaomian
Several cafés near Liziba station
📖 Veg breakfast options: soy milk, vegetable buns, sour noodles without the meat topping

places.name: 重庆北滨一号
places.hook: 嘉陵江北岸最新潮的滨水休闲带，面对渝中半岛壮阔全景，咖啡馆、艺术装置与清爽江风完美融合。
places.hook_en: The trendiest riverside promenade on the north bank of the Jialing River, with sweeping views of the Yuzhong Peninsula — cafés, art installations, and a cool river breeze all in one place.
practical: 全天免费开放，步行或骑行均可
距离李子坝打车约10分钟
建议早晨或傍晚前往，避开正午烈日
practical_en: Free and open all day, great for walking or cycling
About 10 minutes by taxi from Liziba
Best in the morning or evening; avoid the midday heat in August
food: 滨江一带有多家精品咖啡馆和轻食店
推荐找一家有江景座位的咖啡厅休息
📖 大多数咖啡馆提供素食轻食选项
food_en: Several specialty coffee shops and light food spots along the riverside
Find a café with a river view seat and take a well-earned rest
📖 Most cafés here have vegetarian light meal options

places.name: Yescci / Basement FG
places.hook: 重庆独立音乐圈的代表性场馆，地下室里的现场演出充满能量，是感受重庆年轻文化最真实、最有活力的方式。
places.hook_en: An iconic venue in Chongqing's thriving indie music scene — basement live shows full of raw energy. The most authentic way to experience the city's young and creative culture.
practical: 演出门票约50至150元，建议提前在大麦网购买
演出通常在晚上8至9点开场
下午可在附近探索，晚上回来看演出
practical_en: Show tickets around RMB 50–150, buy in advance on Damai app
Shows usually start at 8 to 9pm
Explore the neighbourhood in the afternoon; come back for the evening show
food: 场馆附近有各类餐厅和街边小吃
重庆夜宵文化丰富，演出后可继续宵夜
📖 建议演出前找附近素食餐厅用晚餐
food_en: Restaurants and snack stalls around the venue
Chongqing has a great late-night food culture — supper after the show is a must
📖 Find a vegetarian restaurant nearby for dinner before the show starts

places.name: 磁器口古镇
places.hook: 有着一千七百年历史的古镇，保存了完整的明清街道风貌，茶馆、豆花和麻花是此地三绝，也是购买重庆特产的最佳地点。
places.hook_en: A 1700-year-old ancient town with perfectly preserved Ming and Qing dynasty streets — famous for its teahouses, soft tofu, and twisted fried dough. The best place in Chongqing to shop for local specialities.
practical: 免费进入古镇，部分景点单独收费
建议下午3至5点前往，避开早晨高峰人流
打车或乘轨道交通1号线至磁器口站
practical_en: Free to enter the town; some specific sights charge separately
Afternoon 3 to 5pm is better than morning to avoid the worst crowds
Take a taxi or Metro Line 1 to Ciqikou station
food: 豆花饭是此处招牌，全素版本有嫩豆腐配多种蘸料
麻花为素食，有多种口味可选
📖 老麻花：传统手工油炸点心，为素食，适合买来当伴手礼
food_en: Douhua fan soft tofu with dipping sauces is the signature dish — fully vegetarian version available
Mahua twisted fried dough is vegetarian and comes in many flavours
📖 Mahua is a traditional handmade fried snack, vegetarian, and great to bring home as a gift

places.name: 重庆1949大剧院
places.hook: 以1940年代抗战时期重庆为背景的沉浸式大型演出，场面震撼、灯光绚丽、演员众多，是重庆最值得体验的文化演出之一。
places.hook_en: An epic immersive show set in wartime Chongqing of the 1940s — dramatic staging, spectacular lighting and a cast of hundreds. One of the most unmissable cultural experiences in the city.
practical: 票价约298至598元，需提前网上购票
演出时长约90分钟，通常晚上8点开场
演出场地位于磁器口附近，两处可连续游览
practical_en: Tickets around RMB 298–598, must book online in advance
Show runs about 90 minutes, usually starts at 8pm
Located near Ciqikou — easy to combine both in one afternoon and evening
food: 剧院内有餐厅，建议演出前提前用餐
磁器口附近餐厅是演前晚餐的好选择
📖 建议提前1小时抵达剧院，方便用餐和拍摄剧院外景
food_en: Restaurant inside the theatre — plan to eat before the show starts
Restaurants in nearby Ciqikou are a great dinner option before the show
📖 Arrive at least an hour early to eat, explore, and photograph the venue exterior
